U.note: Charming pocket-calculator look with an LCD, clear key hierarchy and good a11y, though the 9-digit cap and the faint ERR label are small quirks.

V.note: Clean iOS-style dark calculator with a history line, correct arithmetic and keyboard support, but little ARIA and a generic look.

W.note: Beautiful skeuomorphic LCD and keys with CE and shortcut hints, but it is the largest file and goes past basic.

X.note: Plain, correct dark calculator with a bare Error message and a left-aligned 0 label, so it looks the least finished.

Y.note: Tidy dark theme with a blue accent, expression line, backspace and a red Error, correct and cohesive.

Z.note: Light, legible, well-spaced layout with C, CE and backspace, an expression line and a clear divide-by-zero message that fits the display.
